note: Text is copied from the owner's scans of Expansion 1. Scorchia's (scan 0042, (c)2012) is a BASE game card and is not part of this set, which leaves 20 Source cards.

cards.name: Gonzo Shroompuss's
cards.text: Roll 1 die and heal that much HP. Reaction: If you die before this card resolves, discard it to reset your HP to 1 instead. (You didn't die.)

cards.name: Mr. Nukion Fussion's
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to the foe on your right. Reaction: If you die before this card resolves, deal one die of damage to the player who killed you.

cards.name: Griz Glowball's
cards.text: Deal 3 damage to the foe on your left. Pay 2 Blood: Deal 3 damage to each foe instead.

cards.name: Sir Mixs-A-Little's
cards.text: Choose a card type (Source/Quality/Delivery). Each player passes all cards of that type from their hands to the left, and then takes damage equal to the number of cards passed to them. Pay 4 Blood: Double the damage dealt.

cards.name: Goldie Lock's
cards.text: Choose a foe. If that foe gives you a Creature from their hand, add it to your spell. If that foe does not give you a Creature, deal one die of damage to them.

cards.name: A.D.H. Deezi's
cards.text: Take the Standee. If you're taking it from a living foe, deal 3 damage to a different foe.

cards.name: Baconus The Butcher's
cards.text: Heal 1 HP for each Creature in play. Pay X Blood: Heal X additional HP.

cards.name: The Pain Demon's
cards.text: Roll two dice. Use one die to deal damage to the foe on your left. Use the second die to deal damage to yourself, unless you have the Standee or you pay 1 Blood.

cards.name: Queen of the Dead's
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to each foe who already acted this round. Reaction: If you die before this card resolves, draw two extra Dead Wizard cards.

cards.name: Mth'Gurgle Leach'Otep's
cards.text: The foe to your left must give you 2 Blood OR take 3 damage, their choice.

cards.name: Raw-Hydra's
cards.text: Deal 3 damage to your strongest foe. Pay 4 Blood: Deal 7 damage to each foe with a Last Wizard Standing token.

cards.name: Burnin' Banger's
cards.text: Choose one: Either take the Standee and deal 1 damage to each foe OR deal 3 damage to a foe who does not have the Standee. Pay 3 Blood: Do both.

cards.name: The Sly Roller's
cards.text: Roll one die: 1-2 Take the Standee; 3-4 Draw a Treasure; 5+ Do both. Reaction: If you die before this card resolves, draw a Treasure and play it at the start of the next game.

cards.name: Visha' Vindasmack's
cards.text: Add one card from your hand to this spell. Standee: Add two cards instead.

cards.name: Moochie Da' Magic Missiler's
cards.text: Each foe who has already acted this round must give you 1 Blood. Each foe who has not already acted takes 2 damage.

cards.name: Storklox The Unmaker's
cards.text: Deal 2 damage to your strongest foe. Pay 3 Blood: Add a random card from your hand to your spell.

cards.name: Dr. Gravelover's
cards.text: Take the Standee. Pay 1 Blood: Deal 2 damage to each foe for each Last Wizard Standing token in play.

cards.name: Wiz' Sleeve Steve's
cards.text: Deal 1 damage to any foe. Reaction: If you die before this card resolves and you have a Creature in this spell, reveal the Creature and it takes the damage instead. (You didn't die.)

cards.name: The Flaming Prince's
cards.text: Deal 1 damage to each foe. Pay 5 Blood: Deal 5 damage instead.

cards.name: Togongo Valcando's
cards.text: Give your strongest foe 1 Blood, and then deal one die of damage to them. Standee: Then deal one die of damage to a different foe.
